meta.name: Sprunki
meta.desc: It's just another Sprunki remake, so not really much to say here. Also check out the original by nyankobflol!

characters.name: Oren
characters.desc: An avid beatboxer and occansional DJ who's actually pretty famous around these parts, though enjoy beatboxing more. They're also in a relationship with Pinki.

characters.name: Raddy
characters.desc: Though he seems tough like he claims, Raddy actually just likes to play sports, exercise, and hang out with Oren, Durple, and Simon. He also spray-paints walls for some reason.

characters.name: Clukr
characters.desc: A scientist and engineer currently working with Garnold to make robots and stuff. For what, you might ask? Great question.

characters.name: Fun-Bot
characters.desc: A robot built by Clukr and Garnold mostly made as a test of some sorts, but now they spread fun and joy wherever they can, hence their name. They also seem to have a father-son relationship with said creators.

characters.name: Vineria
characters.desc: I don't have much info on her, but she mostly seems to be really into gardening and plants in general. So much, in fact, she has many plant themed outfits to wear.

characters.name: Gray
characters.desc: Despite being a bit of an introvert, he's a pretty chill guy who gets along with others well. They also happen to be a fan of rock music, apparently.

characters.name: brud
characters.desc: A naive guy who co-owns a farm with Mr. Tree and Vineria, yet he's not the sharpest tool in the shed. How ironic.

characters.name: Garnold
characters.desc: An engineer and programmer working with Clukr making robots and such. He actually also made his own cool headgear that makes sound.

characters.name: OWAKCX
characters.desc: He's, needless to say, a little messed up in the head, as he sort of got hit in the head by a wooden plank while he was near a construction site. Otherwise, actually a nice person.

characters.name: Sky
characters.desc: A little dreamer who really likes anything bear-themed, as he is a bear himself. I actually also babysit him sometimes, and I do enjoy spending time with him.

characters.name: Mr. Sun
characters.desc: This is literally the sun. The only reason we actually have a daylight cycle is because he just so happens to have a clone of the sun at the ready, just in case he wants to come down to Earth.

characters.name: Durple
characters.desc: A dragon who has a weird fascination for orchestral instruments. Despite being able to fly, he sometimes prefers to walk. But other than that, he's great friends with Simon.

characters.name: Mr. Tree
characters.desc: A wise guy occasionally giving out pieces of wisdom to those in need of it. They also own a farm with brud and Vineria.

characters.name: Simon
characters.desc: A real video-game nerd, who also happens to have ADHD. He sometimes talks to Durple about some of his favorite games, and Durple is more than happy to listen to him.

characters.name: Tunner
characters.desc: The self-proclaimed sheriff around here, though we're not in a desert. He actually just deals with any quarrels and such to prevent them from escalating to a fight, and he's pretty good at it.

characters.name: Mr. Fun Computer
characters.desc: Another robot created by Clukr and Garnold who actually wasn't a robot first, but was a computer program on Garnold's laptop transfered to a robot body. They also have the same father-son relationship with said creators like Fun-Bot.

characters.name: Wenda
characters.desc: An artist who likes to make really abstract paintings, and sometimes self-portraits. They also seem to have a crush on Gray, but he doesn't know that yet.

characters.name: Pinki
characters.desc: A former jeweler who now works as a popular model around here. Suprisingly, she sometimes makes her own clothes and shows them off as well.

characters.name: Jevin
characters.desc: Have you seen someone in an empty church recently? If so, that was probably me. I'm a cultist, and the one documenting everyone in the Grassland. Despite my "weird" activities, I care for everyone here deeply.

characters.name: Black
characters.desc: None of us know who he is, or what he does. He just claims to be from another part of the Grasslands. I have been looking into this a bit, and he doesn't seem to have any negative intentions, but we can't be too sure.
